battle.name: 奈及利亞內戰
battle.brief: 奈及利亞內戰於一九六七年七月在聯邦政府軍與比亞法拉軍隊之間展開，戰事集中於奈及利亞東部。比亞法拉軍隊使用蘇製AK-47突擊步槍；該正式型號已於一九四九年列裝，是其步兵部隊的重要地面武器，最終戰局由聯邦政府軍取得勝利。

kit.name: 卡莫夫突擊步槍
kit.history: AK-47是蘇聯制式突擊步槍，隸屬步兵分隊的輕武器系統，擔任班與排的自動射擊火力，位階低於通用機槍與火炮。

countries: 1967年的奈及利亞內戰，實質上是聯邦政府與比亞法拉之間的一場內部分裂戰爭。聯邦軍政府掌握北部、西部、首都區及尼日爾河沿線的大部分交通與資源，並由拉各斯等港口取得外部補給；比亞法拉則控制原東部區的森林城鎮、東西公路、尼日爾河東岸與邦尼原油出口設施。聯邦軍與比亞法拉軍並非原先互不相識的外國軍隊，而是同屬奈及利亞武裝力量後，因地域、軍政命令及效忠問題分裂。戰線因此不是固定國界，而沿Onitsha、Awka、Owerri、Aba、Port Harcourt與Umuahia等交通樞紐反覆移動。比亞法拉雖獲若干國家承認，卻未被聯合國接納為會員；聯邦政府始終把其控制區視為奈及利亞領土的一部分。
countriesEn: The Nigerian Civil War of 1967 was fundamentally an internal conflict between the federal government and Biafra. The federal military government controlled most of the northern and western regions, the capital area, and the transport and resources along the Niger River, while obtaining external supplies through ports such as Lagos. Biafra held the forest towns of the former Eastern Region, the East-West Road, the east bank of the Niger, and the Bonny oil export facilities. The opposing forces were not strangers from separate foreign armies: they originated within Nigeria's own armed forces and then divided over regional loyalties, military commands, and political allegiance. The front consequently moved around transport nodes including Onitsha, Awka, Owerri, Aba, Port Harcourt, and Umuahia rather than following a fixed international border. Although several states recognized Biafra, the United Nations did not admit it as a member. The federal government consistently treated territory held by Biafra as part of Nigeria.
people: 比亞法拉領袖Odumegwu Ojukwu出身於原東部區軍事官僚體系，1966年先任東部區軍事首長，後於1967年成為比亞法拉國家元首。Philip Effiong先擔任參謀長，之後接掌比亞法拉第一師等野戰部隊，並在最後階段代表殘餘政府交涉投降；Alexander Madiebo是比亞法拉第二師的重要指揮官，Walter Olegge主持東部海軍司令部，飛行員Sam Mbakwe參與有限空運與近距作戰。聯邦方面由Yakubu Gowon主持軍政，Oladipo Diya在參謀體系中協調作戰，Joseph A. Johnson曾率領主攻Onitsha方向的聯邦第二師；聯邦空軍指揮官Adetokunbo Ademola於1969年1月空難身亡。雙方都有工程、信號、補給、醫療及通信人員，並非只有前線步兵。聯邦軍後來依師、旅、營作戰，比亞法拉則把殘存重裝、砲兵與步兵分散到多個道路防區，抵抗能力相當依賴指揮官能否及時重組兵力。
peopleEn: Odumegwu Ojukwu came from the military administration of the former Eastern Region, served as its military head after 1966, and became the head of Biafra in 1967. Philip Effiong was first Chief of Staff and later commanded field formations such as Biafra's First Division and represented the remnant government during the final surrender negotiations. Alexander Madiebo was an important commander of Biafra's Second Division, Walter Olegge headed the Eastern Naval Command, and pilot Sam Mbakwe took part in limited airlift and close-support operations. On the federal side, Yakubu Gowon directed the military government, Oladipo Diya coordinated operations through the staff system, and Joseph A. Johnson led the federal Second Division in the principal thrust toward Onitsha. Federal Air Force commander Adetokunbo Ademola died in an aircraft crash in January 1969. Neither side consisted only of infantry: engineers, signallers, supply personnel, medical staff, and communications specialists supported the formations. The federal army increasingly fought in divisions, brigades, and battalions, while Biafra dispersed armor, artillery, and infantry among several road defenses, making its resistance dependent on whether commanders could reconcentrate forces in time.
kits: 聯邦軍的裝備核心是英制標準化的小武器、砲兵與車輛，包括9毫米Sterling突擊槍、7.62毫米Bren機槍及FN MAG通用機槍、2英吋迫擊砲、QF 25磅砲、L7系列105毫米野戰砲與4.5英吋榴彈砲。裝甲與偵察主力包括輕型Ferret侦察車、6乘6 Saladin輪式裝甲車及Eland 20噸履帶裝甲運兵車；它們主要負責偵察、火力牽引、指揮與運兵，並不是能抵擋反戰車砲的現代主戰坦克。Dornier Do 28與de Havilland Dove等飛機用於聯絡、觀察和輕量供應。比亞法拉從東部軍械庫取得同類英制武器，也使用少量C-47與DC-3型飛機執行空運；戰爭後期外來援助中的T-34/85、SU-100及PT-76則提供較強的裝甲突擊能力。25磅砲、105毫米砲及迫擊砲各需不同規格的砲彈，7.62毫米武器亦須依實際膛室配發，不能只憑口徑混用。重型砲彈會佔用大量車輛載量，輪式車與履帶車的燃油、輪胎、備件和維修能力，往往比單件武器性能更能限制連續作戰。上述型號均在1967年以前問世並投入軍用。
kitsEn: The core of federal equipment was a British-pattern inventory of small arms, artillery, and vehicles, including the 9 mm Sterling submachine gun, 7.62 mm Bren light machine gun, FN MAG general-purpose machine gun, 2-inch mortar, QF 25-pounder, L7-series 105 mm field gun, and 4.5-inch howitzer. Armored reconnaissance and transport centered on the light Ferret scout car, 6x6 Saladin armored car, and Eland 20-ton tracked personnel carrier. These vehicles served principally in reconnaissance, towing, command, and troop transport rather than functioning as modern main battle tanks capable of withstanding anti-tank fire. Aircraft such as the Dornier Do 28 and de Havilland Dove were used for liaison, observation, and light supply work. Biafra inherited similar British-pattern weapons from eastern depots and also employed a limited number of C-47 and DC-3-type transports. Later foreign assistance supplied T-34/85 tanks, SU-100 tank destroyers, and PT-76 light tanks, giving Biafra a stronger armored striking capability. The 25-pounder, 105 mm gun, and mortars required different ammunition, while 7.62 mm weapons still had to be matched to their actual chambering rather than caliber alone. Heavy artillery rounds consumed substantial vehicle capacity, and fuel, tires, spare parts, and maintenance capacity often limited sustained operations more than the performance of any single weapon. All the listed types had entered military service before 1967.
tactics: 戰爭初期，比亞法拉利用東區既有營區和軍械，迅速控制Enugu、Owerri及Port Harcourt周邊，但企圖沿Onitsha大橋向拉各斯方向擴張時，在狹窄橋面與聯邦守軍的火力下受挫。聯邦軍沒有沿單一道路全速突進，而是以海軍與河流部隊封鎖沿海運輸，以機場、橋梁和道路補給點為打擊目標，再用聯盟公路及內河把師級部隊送往下一個目標。從Ibadan經Ogbomosho、Onitsha與Awka的軸線承擔主要正面推進，另一支部隊則在尼日爾三角洲向Port Harcourt收縮。比亞法拉常以Nsukka、Onitsha、Aba及Owerri附近的交叉路口為支撐，利用砲兵封鎖道路、步兵守據點，並在適合的泥濘地形投入T-34/85或SU-100阻止裝甲車隊通過。聯邦步兵則先由砲兵與空軍削弱道路及城鎮，再以工程部隊處理障礙，使用Eland運兵車越過鬆軟地面，Saladin與Ferret負責側翼偵察。雨季道路泥濘、車隊伸展及燃料消耗常迫使攻勢暫停；比亞法拉把砲位移往不同防區以延長抵抗，但缺少完整替裝與補給。到最後階段，其部隊已集中於Umuahia周邊，縱深縮短，因而更易被聯邦砲兵及步兵分割。
tacticsEn: At the beginning of the war, Biafrans used existing eastern barracks and depots to secure Enugu, Owerri, and the approaches to Port Harcourt, but their attempt to expand west through the Onitsha bridge toward Lagos was checked by federal defenders holding the narrow crossing. The federal army did not rush along one road. It used naval and river forces to interfere with coastal movement, targeted airfields, bridges, and supply points, and shifted divisions along the alliance road and inland waterways. The main frontal thrust followed the axis from Ibadan through Ogbomosho and Onitsha toward Awka, while another formation contracted toward Port Harcourt across the Niger Delta. Biafra relied on road junctions around Nsukka, Onitsha, Aba, and Owerri, using artillery to sweep approaches, infantry to hold strongpoints, and T-34/85 or SU-100 vehicles where muddy ground favored armor and could disrupt advancing columns. Federal infantry used artillery and air action against towns and roads before engineers dealt with physical obstacles; Eland carriers helped cross soft ground, while Saladin and Ferret vehicles screened the flanks. Rainy-season mud, long supply columns, and fuel consumption repeatedly forced pauses. Biafrans shifted guns between defensive sectors to extend their resistance but could not reliably replace equipment or sustain all formations. By the final phase, its forces were concentrated around Umuahia, with little depth and greater exposure to federal artillery and isolation.
data: 時間線可由1967年1月15日第一次軍變及1月28日反軍變開始理解；5月26日，Ojukwu在Enugu宣布比亞法拉成立，聯邦軍則於5月30日開始實際進攻，7月6日後被奈及利亞官方部分紀念活動用作象徵性開戰日。6月的Nsukka戰役中，聯邦軍一度受挫，比亞法拉也在7月再次嘗試向尼日爾河西岸突破。1967年秋冬，聯邦第二師沿Ibadan至Ogbomosho及Onitsha的公路逐步向前，東部首都與主要軍事機場相繼受到威脅；1968年10月14日，聯邦軍攻入Owerri，令比亞法拉主要指揮中心進一步後撤至Umuahia方向。1969年1月3日聯邦軍占領Aba，5月22日Port Harcourt這個長期孤立的地區也落入聯邦控制。聯邦後勤以拉各斯及尼日爾河中游基地為源頭，把砲彈、柴油、輪胎、橋梁工程器材及載人車輛沿公路和內河分送；前線砲兵即使有砲，也可能因連續射擊後彈藥未到而停火。比亞法拉只能轉移現有砲位、使用東部軍械庫及少量外部運輸維持，道路、輪胎與備件的不足逐步壓縮其射擊頻率。1970年1月8日聯邦發動最後攻勢，第2師沿Owerri至Umuahia道路推進，至1月15日占領Umuahia；Ojukwu於1月中旬離境，Ambrose Alli在1月29日宣布投降命令，命令於1月31日中午生效，主要抵抗在2月初停止。
dataEn: The chronology begins with the coup of 15 January 1967 and the countercoup of 28 January. On 26 May, Ojukwu declared the Republic of Biafra in Enugu, while actual federal military operations began on 30 May. Some later Nigerian commemorations consequently use 6 July as a symbolic start date. Federal forces suffered a setback around Nsukka in June, and Biafra made another attempt to break west across the Niger in July. During the second half of 1967, the federal Second Division advanced along the road from Ibadan through Ogbomosho and Onitsha, placing the eastern capital and principal military airfields under increasing pressure. On 14 October 1968 federal troops entered Owerri, forcing the Biafran command center farther toward Umuahia. Federal forces occupied Aba on 3 January 1969 and took the long-isolated Port Harcourt enclave on 22 May. Federal logistics drew ammunition, diesel, tires, bridging equipment, and transport vehicles from depots around Lagos and the middle Niger, then distributed them by road and inland water. A battery could cease firing even when its gun was intact if ammunition did not arrive after a prolonged engagement. Biafra could move existing guns and draw on eastern depots and limited external transport, but shortages of roads, tires, spare parts, and ammunition progressively reduced its rate of fire. The final federal offensive began on 8 January 1970. The Second Division advanced along the Owerri-Umuahia road and occupied Umuahia on 15 January. Ojukwu left Biafra in mid-January, Ambrose Alli announced surrender terms on 29 January, and the order took effect at noon on 31 January, with principal organized resistance ending in early February.
cause: 內戰的直接背景是獨立後聯邦制度沒有妥善處理地區利益、中央權力與軍隊效忠問題。奈及利亞沿襲英國殖民時期的聯邦框架，但北、南、西三區的資源、人口與政治影響並不一致；東部地區因石油與港口收入增加，對聯邦中央控制財政及軍政任命日益不安。1966年兩次軍事政變及隨後的軍官清除，使聯邦軍隊指揮系統破碎，東區軍官與中央軍政之間也形成難以修復的猜疑。Ojukwu政府認為聯邦已無法保住東部自治；聯邦政府則不能接受任何地區以既有軍區和行政機構分離。1967年5月的十二州改組進一步改變聯邦權力關係，使東部領袖相信地方安全與資源權力將持續受到中央限制。比亞法拉並非只因單一矛盾成立，而是把制度分歧、軍隊分裂及對聯邦未來的不信任集中在分離行動上。聯邦拒絕承認獨立，並採取軍事方式恢復統一，衝突遂從政治談判轉為全面戰爭。
causeEn: The immediate background was the failure of the post-independence federal system to resolve disputes over regional interests, central authority, and military loyalty. Nigeria inherited a British colonial federal framework, but the resources, population, and political influence of the northern, southern, and eastern regions were not equal. As petroleum income and port revenues increased in the east, eastern leaders grew more concerned about federal control over finance and senior appointments. The coups of 1966 and the subsequent removal or killing of officers shattered the federal command structure and deepened mistrust between eastern military officers and the central government. The Ojukwu administration concluded that the federation could no longer preserve eastern autonomy; the federal government could not accept the separation of a region through its existing military districts and administrative machinery. The creation of twelve states in May 1967 changed the balance of federal power and reinforced eastern fears that local authority and resources would continue to be diminished. Biafran separatism therefore concentrated several accumulated problems, including constitutional distrust, divided military allegiance, and fear of centralization. The federal government refused to recognize secession and chose military means to restore the territorial union, turning a political dispute into a general war.
impact: 這場戰爭首先改變了聯邦軍隊的技術與制度。聯邦由原本規模有限、偏重國內治安的軍隊，轉為能以師旅作戰、維持砲兵dependences、使用裝甲車與內河運輸的常備軍；道路工程、戰地醫療、燃料分配及高頻砲戰經驗成為後來軍事現代化的基礎。比亞法拉的外交處境則十分有限：法國與蘇聯先後承認它，但其在聯合國的席位始終未被接納；英國與美國在外交上支持聯邦領土完整或要求停止戰鬥，非洲統一組織曾調解，卻沒有以區域部隊介入。戰爭亦重創聯邦財政，邦尼等東部石油出口設施一度停擺，外匯與政府收入受到嚴重影響；停火後聯邦取得東部油區及港口，為下一階段石油經濟擴張提供條件。軍事上，聯邦獲得完整師級編制、裝甲運用與長距離補給經驗，許多後來在奈及利亞政治中具有影響力的軍官，也在戰區指揮或參謀崗位任職。與此同時，比亞法拉軍隊解體，殘餘人員分散到聯邦軍、地方行政及私人保安體系，使聯邦中央與東部軍政之間的長期張力仍未消失。
impactEn: The war first transformed the structure and technical capabilities of the federal armed forces. What had been a relatively small force oriented toward domestic security developed into a standing army capable of division and brigade operations, sustained artillery dependence, armored vehicle employment, and inland-water transport. Road engineering, field medical support, fuel distribution, and the demands of frequent artillery engagements became foundations of later military modernization. Biafra's diplomatic position remained limited. France and the Soviet Union recognized it, but the United Nations never admitted it as a member. Britain and the United States diplomatically supported Nigerian territorial integrity or called for an end to hostilities, while the Organization of African Unity attempted mediation without committing regional troops. The conflict also severely strained federal finances. Oil export facilities in the east, including Bonny, were temporarily shut, reducing foreign exchange and government income. After the ceasefire, federal control of eastern oil fields and ports became central to the subsequent expansion of the petroleum economy. Militarily, the federal government gained experience in full division structures, armored operations, and long-range logistics, and many officers who later shaped Nigerian politics had served in operational or staff positions. At the same time, the Biafran armed forces dissolved, while former personnel dispersed into the federal army, local administration, and private security networks, leaving enduring tension between federal authority and eastern military politics.
result: 最後一階段的勝負由交通與補給決定。聯邦第二師沿Owerri至Umuahia道路逐段攻進，其他部隊封鎖南側與河谷出口；砲兵可由後方安全地域支援前面步兵，而比亞法拉殘餘車輛在道路與燃料不足下難以保持整建制。1970年1月15日Umuahia被占領後，剩餘控制區已失去主要道路樞紐，Ojukwu於同月中旬離開並前往科特迪瓦。Ambrose Alli在1月29日宣布有條件投降，自1月31日中午生效；Effiong與主要幕僚隨後向聯邦軍交出權力，主要有組織抵抗於2月初終止。聯邦在軍事上達成消滅比亞法拉分級政府的目標，原東部區被重新劃分為多個聯邦行政單位，部分前比亞法拉軍官與士兵被整編、赦免或留在地方軍政體系。勝方並未因此消除內戰造成的軍事與政治代價，聯邦軍隊規模和機械化程度顯著增加，中央與地區間的權力爭執反而延續至戰後。傷亡方面，雙方均留下不完整名冊，俘虜、失蹤與重複計算的處理也不一致；較可靠的是軍人死亡達數萬，部分研究把雙方總數置於十萬量級附近，因此不宜採用任何聲稱精確到個位的傷亡數字。
resultEn: The outcome of the final phase was determined by movement and logistics. The federal Second Division advanced in sections along the Owerri-Umuahia road while other formations closed approaches to the south and river valleys. Artillery could be supported from rear areas without moving far behind the forward infantry, whereas Biafra's remaining vehicles found it increasingly difficult to retain cohesive formations because of damaged roads and inadequate fuel. After Umuahia was occupied on 15 January 1970, the remaining controlled territory had lost its principal transport junction. Ojukwu left Biafra later that month and went to Côte d'Ivoire. Ambrose Alli announced conditional surrender terms on 29 January, effective at noon on 31 January. Effiong and his senior staff subsequently transferred authority to federal forces, and principal organized resistance ended in early February. Militarily, the federal government had destroyed Biafra's separatist government. The former Eastern Region was reorganized into several federal administrative units, and some former Biafran officers and soldiers were integrated, pardoned, or retained in local military and political structures. Victory did not remove the costs of the war or eliminate political tensions: the federal army became substantially larger and more mechanized, while conflict between central authority and regional power continued after the ceasefire. Casualty records on both sides are incomplete, and prisoners, missing personnel, and duplicate records were handled inconsistently. Military deaths were clearly measured in tens of thousands, and some studies place the combined total near the scale of 100,000, so no exact figure should be treated as established.
